openQuestions.text: Jester's and Olympia's three recruit quests aren't described (RPG Site lists "3x Quest"); Game8 mentions Scarlet Drops for Olympia.
Earliest Giant's Meat: the desert opens in Ch 8 and the Giant skirmishes run about Lv 35, so Goliath may join later than Renown 6 suggests.
Sources don't say where Jester, Goliath, Simon, Olympia and Gaitz stand in Dagsion before they join: use Map > People, which lists and teleports.
No source names the shop that sells the Mature Blush (Catching Sweetie's Eye, due 6/15): check the Item Shop, Marketplace and Vandahl. Garum sources aren't named either.
The Renown pace comes from one Dietrich clear (Renown 10 at the start of Ch 12, 12 at the end); your pace can differ by a level either way.
Lv 20 and Lv 35 timing per unit isn't documented. Player data (Dietrich about Lv 38 at the end of Part I, most of the team Lv 30 to 35, 7 to 8 Advanced) puts the exams in Ch 10 to 12.
Subquests are semi-random: some listed may not show up, others may appear instead. My Late Sister's Accessory is reported on Dietrich's Ch 9 by one community source.

For the Empire's Safety didn't appear in Ch 8 in at least one Dietrich game, and Game8 doesn't list it for every path; Captain Daniel stands in Hightown (Game8) or Temple Row. If it never shows, the Ch 9 Paralogues cover the Renown and no Sealed Letter follow-up appears in Ch 10.
Uncharted Isle: the guides call Ch 8 Dietrich's only Part I chance, but in one game the route never opened during the Sea Tyrant hunt.
Olympia's join class: one source says Priest?. A Priest can still go straight to Ovate once Black Magic reaches B.
Anna's Paralogue is listed 9/29 to 10/5, but Ch 10 free time ends 10/4: do it by 10/4.
Talimun's first window is 9/17 to 9/19 here and 9/17 to 9/22 on Cai's path; the 10/1 to 10/10 window and the 10/12 deadline match.
Oko's chapter: RPG Site lists him in Ch 10, Game8 in Ch 12 at Renown 10. Dread Warriors appear by Renown, so watch for him at Renown 10.
Can't Stay Home and The Hunter for Gisco's Treasure are listed under Ch 12 with 10/24 deadlines, which fall in your Ch 11.
Blacksmith unlock cost: AllThings.How says 20 shards per boost (200 total), RPG Site estimates about 400. Smyrnos Blessing Lv 1 as a condition is GameRant only.
Thermae Turn cost isn't documented; Game8 frames it as an alternative to resting, so it probably costs none. Bath prices and pools are Game8 only.
Giant's Ring: no source lists it in Anna's shop; a Vandahl barter in Alecto (Paradise Fish x1?) is reported but unverified.
Answerer Arisen from Fabio's Ch 12 scene is Game8 only.
Game8 says unrecruited Jester, Dante and Goliath fight for Bertrand in Ch 11; whether they can still be recruited afterwards isn't stated.
The Ch 4 qualifier lists Cai as a loss condition and Tialla as an ally; the ally list may be slightly off.
Silver weapons have no known source on this route.
Part II deploys up to 15 according to one source; the Part II carry rule says "equipped", read here as each unit's own 6 items.
Part II sets Magic Echo Shards to 100 each chapter (one video source).
Halvin's support partners: the route plan lists Dietrich, Fabio and Jester; halvin.json lists Dietrich and Zarcone. No source settles it.
